issues.description: The type of the price field/parameter for StockIngredient is inconsistent: the problem statement's class diagram specifies an int price and the solution implementation uses an int price, but the template implementation declares price as a double (and its constructor/getPrice use double). This mismatch can confuse students implementing SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice (which is specified to return int) and lead to type/casting or compilation issues when summing ingredient prices.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the StockIngredient price type consistent across all artifacts. Change the template's StockIngredient.price, constructor parameter, and getPrice return type from double to int so they match the problem statement and the solution. Alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to use double if prices are intended to be fractional, but ensure all three artifacts use the same type.
